en: [Field Medic] A <Reserve Operator - Medic> appears on every player's Field; at battle start, if there are at least 2 Elite Operators on the field, it is replaced by <Touch>

3 distinct Yan on board
Yan members (+Harmony members) ATK x(1 + 0.23 + 0.009*L).

At battle start spawn 1 "Yanyou" (enemy_9012_acloon template, allied flying ranged unit, not blockable, moves on its own). ATK = 0.30 x sum(ATK of Yan operators on board at battle start), maxHP = 0.30 x sum(maxHP of those operators). Template: DEF 200, RES 0, BAT 2.5 s, ASPD 100, attack range radius 2.0 tiles, magic damage, hits up to 3 targets; every hit adds Burn Damage (burn elemental damage) = 20% of its ATK and applies Elemental Fragility (elemental damage taken x1.2) to enemies within 0.8 tiles of the target. Skill "Evil-Purging Flame": cooldown 15 s (first cast 15 s after spawn), channels a flame on one enemy in range dealing 60% ATK magic damage per second to it and to enemies within 1.0 tile, for up to 20 s.
Spawn 2 Yanyou instead; each has ATK x1.5 and takes 90% less damage (damage_resistance 0.9).

Economy-driven: Leizi on gain +shop level (no activation needed); Xiaoman at Rest Phase end +1 per operator gained this round; Dusk +2 Yan/Arcane per operator gained; Lu Wuguan on gain +6 Yan +3 Marvel; Hoshiguma on gain +8 own bonds; Zhuhuang on gain +5 Yan/Victoria; Improv "Swire's Oath" +10. Strategy Du Yaoye: first 2 manual refreshes each round prefer a Yan operator.
Buy many operators each round (every gain feeds Xiaoman/Dusk), rush 6 Yan for the Yanyou spike; Swire the Elegant Wit / Swire give early gold. 9 Yan is a late-game luxury.
Yanyou base stats are replaced (not added) by the 30% sums
Evil-Purging Flame hit_duration=20 read as 20 one-second ticks

Whenever any Sargon member activates its skill, every Sargon member on the field gains one stack: ASPD +12 for (5 + 0.22*L) s. Each stack has its own timer; at most 25 concurrent stacks (=> +300 ASPD cap).
6 distinct AND strategy Narantuya (band_narant)

Replaces the 6-member effect: when a Sargon member activates its skill, operators on its 8 surrounding tiles also enjoy the effects of the equipment (tier <= V, filter_item_level 5) it carries, for 60 s (base_power_time 60, power_time_per_stack 0).

In battle on skill activation: Philae +6 per skill activation, Gavial the Invincible +9 per skill activation, Papyrus +5 on first skill activation, Titi +1 Sargon/Precision per sleep/stun in range (<=24/battle); Estelle on gain +2; Improv "Titi's Oath" +10. Strategy Pepe: after shop level 2/4/6 one special refresh preferring Sargon.
Fast-cycling skills (Sargon Strong Tea / Yellow Sand Compass items) keep many stacks alive; L mainly extends duration, so stacks overlap more.
stack granted to all Sargon members including the caster

Victoria members that carry >= 1 equipment: all damage dealt x(1.25 + 0.008*L).
Gain 1 Victorian Hammer with a random special effect (pool_equip_vict).
Victoria members: ATK +50% per equipped item; an advanced (Elite/golden) item gives +80% instead (atk_normal_equip 0.5 + atk_golden_equip 0.3).

Rest Phase end: Pale Green +2 per distinct tier of Victoria on board, Vina Victoria +3 per distinct tier (and Marvel +2 per distinct tier of Marvel), Wild Rose +1, Horn +2 per distinct-tier operator of the highest-layer bond; in battle: Bagpipe first 3 kills +2 Victoria/Foresight/Resilient; Zhuhuang on gain +5; Improv "Bagpipe's Oath" +8. Strategy Harold: from round 4 gain 1 Victoria operator every 2 rounds.
Field Victoria of as many different tiers as possible (T1..T6) for Pale Green/Vina; hand all equipment (incl. free hammers) to Victoria carries; Heart of Steam copies all hammer effects.
pool_equip_vict = uniform random among Burning/Sturdy/Swift/Tremble Victorian Hammer (normal grade)

<<@autochess.dgreen>6</> different [Kjerag] Operators on field> Every 25 seconds a cold wind sweeps the Battlefield, making enemies Cold for a duration<@autochess.gray>(affected by Stacks)</>

[Kjerag] Operators' damage increased to <@ba.vup>125%</>, and to <@ba.vup>{0:0%}</> against Cold and Frozen enemies<@ba.acrem>(affected by Stacks)</>
<<@ba.vup>6</> different [Kjerag] Operators on field> Every 25 seconds a cold wind sweeps the Battlefield, making enemies Cold for <@ba.vup>{1:0}</> seconds<@ba.acrem>(affected by Stacks)</>
Kjerag members deal damage x1.25; against enemies that are Cold (cold) or Frozen (frozen) x(1.35 + 0.01*L) instead.
Every 25 s a cold wind applies Cold to every enemy on the field for (20 + 0.1*L) s.

In battle, freeze-driven: Pramanix and SilverAsh - each enemy in range that becomes frozen: 50% chance +1; SilverAsh the Reignfrost gives the Kjerag operator in front of it a 60% version (<=200/battle); Degenbrecher on deploy +8 own active bonds (<=24/battle). On gain: Matterhorn +2, Cliffheart +3 (hidden), Snowhunter +5, Gnosis +5, Degenbrecher +8. Improv "SilverAsh's Oath" +8. Strategy Hyruth: first Kjerag bought each round costs 1.

Standard AK rule: applying Cold to an already-cold enemy freezes it. The 6-member wind + cold-on-hit sources (Kjerag Unmelting Ice 12% 1.5 s cold) create constant freezes, so layers can reach hundreds per battle.
Bahamut: avoid lighting 3 Arcane alongside max-layer Kjerag (Saint Pramanix gets damage-capped).

Ammo consumption in battle: Executor the Ex Foedere each 7 bullets +7 Laterano (7 triggers => 49/battle) and +3 Foresight (<=21/battle); Mostima ops in its 4 adjacent tiles each 6 ammo +1; Lemuen each 10 bullets with 3 ops in its row +2 Laterano/Precision; Executor first kill +3 Precision/Laterano. Prep: Archetto on entering Rest Phase +3 to self and front tile operator's active bonds. Improv "Mostima's Oath" +10. Strategy Pagnini: after spending 55 gold gain a random elite T4+ Laterano.
Only ammo-skill operators benefit from the 3-tier; the bond is weak until 6 (Bahamut: "3-member effect is weak").

<<@autochess.dgreen>5</> different [Aegir] Operators on field> The first 3 [Aegir] Operators <@ba.vup>immediately revive</> when knocked out for the first time

[Aegir] Operators HP <@ba.vup>+{0:0%}</><@ba.acrem>(affected by Stacks)</>
At battle start, [Aegir] Operators in turn devour the Operator 1 tile in front, dealing <@ba.vdown>5000</> Physical damage and gaining its <@ba.vup>base ATK</> and <@ba.vup>Block</>, and gain Alliance Stacks equal to the devoured unit's Tier<@ba.acrem>(among [Aegir], Operators further left and higher up devour first)</>
<<@ba.vup>5</> different [Aegir] Operators on field> The first 3 [Aegir] Operators <@ba.vup>immediately revive</> when knocked out for the first time
Aegir members maxHP x(1 + 0.35 + 0.01*L).
Devour: see algorithm.
The first 3 Aegir members to be knocked out (first time each) revive immediately (max_free_respawn_cnt 3).
Order: Aegir members sorted leftmost first, then topmost ("further left and higher up").

Each Aegir in order marks the unit on the tile directly in front of it (its facing direction) and also the front-tile unit of every Aegir it has marked (chain). It never marks itself, a unit it already marked, or a unit that marked it.

After all marks are placed, each mark makes its target suffer one 5000-point physical HP loss (HP loss, source = the target itself; if it dies, the kill is credited to the marker), resolved in marking order. A target that dies cancels its remaining pending marks.
Each devoured unit adds layers to Aegir equal to its tier (1-6), once per unit per battle.

Devour (tier per devoured unit, every battle); Specter knocked out +3; Specter the Unchained knocked out/substitute swap +5 Aegir +5 Resilient; Skadi each 2 kills +1 Aegir/Durable/Raid; Haini first kill (enemy or ally) +3 Aegir/Arcane; Improv "Skadi's Oath" +8. Strategy Clemensa: an Aegir knocked out adds layers = its tier.
